title: On Adaptive Step Sizes for Eligibility Traces in Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms store agent-environment interactions in a replay buffer and later learn by sampling transitions from it. However, this approach can be memory-inefficient and can delay learning because the agent can learn from a transition only when the buffer samples it. Additionally, most of these methods use one-step or short multi-step temporal-difference (TD) updates, which are slow at credit assignment. An alternative approach is to learn from the stream of observations as they arrive without relying on a buffer. Eligibility-trace algorithms allow these incremental updates and can also assign credit over many steps. These algorithms were common with linear function approximation but have only recently been used in deep RL. translated_title: 深度强化学习中资格迹的自适应步长研究
translated_abstract: 许多深度强化学习（RL）算法将智能体与环境的交互存储在经验回放缓冲区中，之后通过从中采样转移数据来进行学习。然而，这种方法可能在内存使用上效率低下，并且会延迟学习，因为智能体只有在缓冲区采样到某个转移数据时才能从中学习。此外，这些方法大多使用单步或短多步时序差分（TD）更新，这在信用分配方面速度较慢。另一种方法是在观测数据流到达时直接从中学习，而不依赖缓冲区。资格迹算法允许这种增量式更新，并且能够在多步上进行信用分配。这些算法在线性函数逼近时代很常见，但直到最近才被应用于深度强化学习。一些基本问题，例如如何在深度强化学习设置中将向量步长与资格迹结合使用，仍然悬而未决。在这项工作中，我们首先表明自适应向量步长必须……
tldr: 本文研究了深度强化学习中一个悬而未决的基本问题——如何在资格迹算法中使用自适应向量步长，提出了一种不依赖经验回放缓冲区的流式学习方法。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses the open fundamental question of how to use adaptive vector step sizes with eligibility traces in deep reinforcement learning, enabling buffer-free streaming learning with incremental multi-step credit assignment.
